sources: Existing SD2.1 phase1_trajectory_native_gs_20261113 aux and same, ordinary generations of each prompt with independent seeds. Check source image hashes, distinct pixels and seeds.
split: Within each dataset sort unique prompts by SHA256 of color-id-v1/ followed by the exact caption. First 20 prompts calibrate, remaining 30 evaluate; keep both seeds and all edits together.
waves: Unmodified WAVES single-image distortions via the project's frozen loader. Same edit RNG for both seeds within a prompt/condition. No fake images or new generations.
conditions: All 16 edited conditions equally weighted; unedited self comparisons are audit checks only. Different-seed negative is the identical edited query against the other original.
features: RGB shares of total channel intensity
joint chromaticity and three absolute luma bands
joint chromaticity and three relative luma thirds (fractional split of equal-luma ties)
distance: Hellinger on unit-mass distributions, single original template per image; equal mass per channel for marginal RGB. All pixels used; exact black has neutral chromaticity.
threshold: Primary: largest attainable calibration acceptance at or below 5% different-seed false accepts using a single threshold per feature, equal weight across edit types, inclusive <=; put boundary just below first excluded order statistic. Secondary: smallest distance threshold accepting >=95% genuine calibration queries. Calibration finishes before test scoring.
identification: Nearest original among the two siblings, and top-1 among all 120 test originals. Exact distance ties receive fractional credit. Also report hard impostor acceptance for clean unedited siblings separately.
uncertainty: Paired stratified prompt-cluster percentile bootstrap (COCO/SDP, 5000 replicates, PCG64 seed 20261119), frozen thresholds and gallery; no individual edit treated as independent.
execution: 249 CPU only. No model inference or optimization.
